source: Items from the public-domain International Personality Item Pool (IPIP, ipip.ori.org), lightly adapted to first-person spoken English. 6 per domain, 3 forward and 3 reversed.

scale.prompt_suffix: Not at all, a little, somewhat, mostly, or completely?

openness.name: Openness
openness.high: curious, imaginative, drawn to ideas and novelty

extraversion.name: Extraversion
extraversion.low: reserved, recharges alone, lets others lead

agreeableness.name: Agreeableness
agreeableness.high: warm, cooperative, tuned to others' feelings

orderliness.name: Orderliness
orderliness.why: predicts how much structure a person builds and keeps around their work

assertiveness.name: Assertiveness
assertiveness.why: predicts who speaks first and takes charge in a room

scoring_notes: Each domain is the mean of its 6 items after reversing negative-polarity items (6 minus answer), mapped to 0-100 as (mean - 1) / 4 * 100, so 50 = neutral. Levels: below 35 low, 35-65 average, above 65 high. Facets are the same formula over the items tagged with that facet. Domain confidence = agreement between the forward and reversed halves (1 minus their gap over 4) times a coverage factor; overall confidence is the mean across domains. See scoring.ts.
